---
title: "Special sections"
subtitle: "References, appendices and supplementary material in Typst."
description: "How mcanouil-typst orders and numbers the references, appendix and supplementary sections of a single document and of a book, with the embedded typst-extras tool."
---

Three classes on a level 1 heading make a special section.
The embedded [typst-extras](../reference.qmd#typst-extras) tool numbers the appendix and supplementary sections in every Typst document type.

| Class | Numbering | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `.references` | none | References |
| `.appendix` | letters | Appendix A: Title, A.1, Figure A.1, (A.1) |
| `.supplementary` | `S` prefix | S1, S1.1, Figure S1, Table S1 |

: The special sections and their numbers. {.striped .hover tbl-colwidths="[22,18,60]"}

## Single document

In a single document, the special sections move to the end, in this order:

1. The body.
2. The references.
3. The appendices.
4. The supplementary sections.

You can write them anywhere in the source.

```markdown
# Introduction

The study has two arms [@doe2026].

# Supplementary material {.supplementary}

![A supplementary figure.](extra.svg){#fig-extra fig-alt="A grey rectangle."}

# Extra analyses {.appendix}

## Data sources

# References {.references}

::: {#refs}
:::
```

The bibliography goes in the `#refs` div.
The references stay last before the appendices.
An appendix heading reads "Appendix A: Extra analyses", and the running header uses the same text.
A cross-reference to the appendix reads "Appendix A".
The body floats keep their plain numbers: Figure 1, Figure 2.

To change the numbers, use the `sections` options of typst-extras:

```yaml
extensions:
  typst-extras:
    sections:
      appendix-delimiter: ""
      supplementary-prefix: "SM"
```

With these values, Figure A.1 becomes Figure A1, and Figure S1 becomes Figure SM1.

## Book project

In a book, the appendices come from `book: appendices:` in `_quarto.yml`, not from the `.appendix` class.
They are lettered A, B, with sub-headings A.1, A.2.
To make supplementary chapters, put `.supplementary` on the level 1 heading of the last chapters.
In a book, a supplementary chapter stays where it is.

```{.markdown filename="sections/04-extra.qmd"}
# Extra material {.supplementary}

## Extra figure
```

This chapter is "S1 Extra material", with a sub-heading "S1.1 Extra figure" and floats numbered Figure S1.

## Chapter numbers in captions

Set Quarto's `crossref.chapters: true` to number floats per chapter: Figure 1.1, Figure 2.1.

```yaml
crossref:
  chapters: true
```

In the types that do not number their headings, such as the compact report, the floats keep flat numbers: Figure 1, Figure 2.
See the [known limitations](../limitations.qmd) for the other types.
